candidate: ETIX Lille #1 data centre, 101 Boulevard Constantin Descat, 59200 Tourcoing (Nord), France
coordinate_reference_system: API Carto returns the parcel as GeoJSON in WGS84 longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326). The parcel was projected to EPSG:2154 (RGF93 v1 / Lambert-93) with pyproj 3.7.1 (always_xy=True), its planar area centroid computed with shapely 2.1.1, and the centroid transformed back to EPSG:4326. BD TOPO footprints were requested in EPSG:2154; address points were projected to EPSG:2154 for distances.
source_selection: ETIX publishes the Lille #1 address as 101 Bd Constantin Descat, 59200 Tourcoing. The Géoplateforme geocoder returns that exact housenumber (BAN 59599_1402_00101, score 0.98) at 3.156502, 50.699966; API Carto queried at that point returns the single parcel 59599000IM0521, whose area centroid is used.

The centroid falls on a light-roofed block within a dense urban complex of large flat-roofed buildings with circular roof features, beside terraced housing; the data centre (480 m2 of IT rooms per ETIX's EED workbook) cannot be distinguished from the rest of the complex, so the point locates the address parcel only.

method: shapely 2.1.1 planar area centroid of the cadastral parcel in EPSG:2154 (pyproj 3.7.1), transformed to WGS84; containment and distances computed in EPSG:2154; BD TOPO buildings tested for intersection with the parcel and containment of the centroid.
